stories.title: Amazon slashes another 16,000 jobs
stories.summary: Amazon just cut 16,000 employees, adding to 14,000 positions eliminated in October. We explore the driving forces behind these layoffs, and the broader trend in tech that it's a part of.

stories.title: U.S. allies looking to China for deals as U.S. threats them with tariffs
stories.summary: President Trump's tariffs and rhetoric have spurred some longtime U.S. allies to diversify their trade ties away from the U.S. Some are going cap-in-hand to Asian superpowers China and India.

stories.title: Humpback whales cast bubble nets to catch prey. They may be learning from each other
stories.summary: Humpback whales will sometimes use an intricate strategy to catch food called bubble-net feeding. A new study suggests they're spreading the knowledge of how to do it to each other.

stories.title: A snow-starved January is bringing economic pain to the U.S. West
stories.summary: Colorado and Utah are reporting their lowest snowpacks in recorded history. Skier visits at major resorts are way down. Without snow to refresh reservoirs, water managers are sounding alarms.

stories.title: Despite free testing, some schools have been slow to check for lead in their water
stories.summary: There's federal money for local schools to test their water for lead, which can be dangerous for kids. Many school systems opt not to test their faucets, even if it's free.

stories.title: Beloved Crimson Tide practice referee Eddie Conyers dies at 97
stories.summary: Eddie Conyers, a 97-year-old football practice referee at the University of Alabama, has died. He spent six decades working with some of the most notable coaches to get teams ready for game day.
